items: Make your own witch while the forest grows: the game opens in her treehouse room (a mirror, and a banner: PARTY TONIGHT) and you dress her up: hat (shape, height, lean, brim), hair, top and cloak, broom, accessories and the colour of every part, with Randomise and Classic buttons
Start shows how far the forest has grown; press it early and she's "getting ready" until it's done, then straight into play
She's remembered on this browser for next time
Every look keeps her a witch: always a pointed hat with its glowing band, and a broom
